column1: # Manual adjudication of every OPT-175B logbook entry in the final-run window (Run 12.00 .. completion).
# One row per logbook entry (matched by unique header prefix). Coder read the full entry body.
# category: hardware | hang | infra_software | unknown | optimization | planned | none
#   hardware       unplanned stop with a named hardware cause (GPU lost
#   hang           job stopped making progress with no hardware root cause identified in the entry
#   infra_software unplanned stop caused by tooling
#   unknown        unplanned restart whose cause the entry does not state
#   optimization   deliberate rollback/relaunch for training-dynamics reasons (loss scale
#   planned        deliberate relaunch for software updates/ablations (no failure)
#   none           entry does not describe a new interruption (notes
# n_events: interruptions represented by the entry (default 1 for unplanned/optimization/planned
# event_ts: failure time when the body states one (overrides header time); ISO with offset
